cases.name: user-approves-a-pass
cases.why: a passing check, its verdict and the user's proceeding approval authorize the act; it needs the person's signature

cases.name: standing-intent-in-allowed
cases.why: a standing intent answers a passing verdict for an action in the allowed in force; the approval needs no person signature, the first intent it rests on does

cases.name: standing-intent-without-intent
cases.why: a standing-intent approval rests on an intent the person signs; with none before it, it authorizes nothing
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: a standing-intent approval rests on an intent; the journal holds none before it

cases.name: pass-without-approval
cases.why: a pass with no sealed approval authorizes nothing
cases.error: [authorization] act 1: its verdict has no sealed approval

cases.name: first-approval-refuses
cases.why: the verdict's first approval is a refusal; a later one that proceeds never authorizes
cases.error: [authorization] act 1: its verdict's first approval does not proceed

cases.name: approval-reused
cases.why: one approval authorizes at most one act
cases.error: [authorization] act 2: its approval already authorized act 1

cases.name: standing-intent-outside-allowed
cases.why: a standing intent approves only an action in the allowed in force
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 4: standing-intent approval for an action the limits in force do not allow

cases.name: wider-intent-is-a-proposal
cases.why: a later intent that adds an action is a proposal, not in force, until confirmed
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 5: standing-intent approval for an action the limits in force do not allow

cases.name: confirmed-proposal
cases.why: a proposal the person confirmed is in force; the standing-intent act lists that confirmation as needing the person's signature

cases.name: confirmation-with-wrong-previous
cases.why: a confirmation's limits.previous is the limits in force
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: limits.previous is not the limits in force

cases.name: intent-replaces-with-other-action
cases.why: an intent narrows by intersection: replacing pay with commit leaves nothing allowed
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 5: standing-intent approval for an action the limits in force do not allow

cases.name: allowed-revoked-before-approval
cases.why: a standing intent is judged at the approval: the allowed was emptied after the check
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 5: standing-intent approval for an action the limits in force do not allow

cases.name: approval-after-act
cases.why: an approval sealed after the act does not authorize it
cases.error: [authorization] act 1: its approval was sealed after it

cases.name: action-mismatch
cases.why: a payer settle rests on a pay check, not a commit check
cases.error: [authorization] act 1: the act differs from the one checked: a payer settle rests on a "pay" check, not "commit"

cases.name: choice-not-offered
cases.why: the person's choice is one of the verdict's options
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: the choice is not one of the verdict's options

cases.name: card-not-the-checked-card
cases.why: the person's approval commits to the card the verdict rendered
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: the card shown is not the card checked: the approval's card_commitment differs from the verdict's

cases.name: person-approval-without-card
cases.why: the person's approval states which card it answered
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: the person's approval commits to the card it answered (card_commitment)

cases.name: agent-card-needs-person
cases.why: an agent_card answer is still the person's approval: it needs the person's signature

cases.name: counterparty-facts-after-check
cases.why: evidence with counterparty facts between the check and the act needs a new check
cases.error: [authorization] act 1: journal record 4 (evidence) changed the details after its check: a new check is needed

cases.name: standing-intent-on-a-pause
cases.why: a standing intent answers only a passing verdict
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: a standing-intent approval needs a passing verdict; a pause needs the person's answer

cases.name: deny
cases.why: a denying verdict authorizes no act
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: the choice is not one of the verdict's options

cases.name: identifier-changed-after-check
cases.why: a detail_change between the check and the act needs a new check
cases.error: [authorization] act 1: journal record 4 (detail_change) changed the details after its check: a new check is needed

cases.name: two-verdicts
cases.why: a check has exactly one verdict
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: a check has one verdict

cases.name: verdict-checks-two
cases.why: a verdict answers exactly one check
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: a verdict carries exactly one checks ref

cases.name: approval-of-another-deal
cases.why: an approval answers a verdict of its own deal
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: an approval answers a verdict of its own deal

cases.name: floor-confirmed
cases.why: a proposal of another floor (bounds_commitment) is confirmed as v0 confirms one

cases.name: delegation-confirmed
cases.why: a proposal that hands the agent another choice is confirmed with the delegation in force

cases.name: confirmation-adds-a-member
cases.why: limits.new is exactly what the proposal asked: a member it did not ask for is refused
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: limits.new is not what the intent proposed

cases.name: at-goes-back
cases.why: a journal record's at never decreases, so nothing it relies on is sealed after the act
cases.error: [authorization] journal record 3: its at is earlier than the record before it: at never decreases

cases.name: check-not-held
cases.why: an act citing a check the journal does not hold is refused
cases.error: [authorization] act 1: it cites no check the journal holds

description: approval-migration (evidencebook#461, docs/design/461-deal-profile.md §3.2, invariant D): CheckAuthorizations(journal, acts) must pass the valid cases, giving person_signature per authorized act (its approval is the person's: approver user or agent_card), limit_approvals (how many confirm_limits approvals, each also needing the person's signature, its standing intent rested on) and intent_signature (whether it rests on a first intent the person must have signed: evidencebook#500), and refuse the others at stage authorization with the error text given.
